item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. Your evening's already built for it — wind-down, muscle relaxation, and a set bedtime on the calendar. That structure only works if you actually protect it instead of letting the day's last tasks bleed into it. Stop checking notes and screens once wind-down starts. Action: when relaxation time hits tonight, close the laptop and don't reopen it before lights out.
